purpose: Measure whether Meta_Kim governance improves real task outcomes instead of only increasing packet or schema completeness.

experiment.workspaceIsolation: one external OS-temp workspace per trial, with trial-scoped AGENTS.md instructions, an independent Git root, and an immutable starter commit
experiment.codexBackend: the project's native Codex CLI runtime; no Docker, WSL, or alternate provider
experiment.codexApprovalReviewer: auto_review, the native Codex headless path that preserves on-request approval instead of forcing approval_policy=never
experiment.codexWritableRootBinding: --cd points to an external per-trial Git repository with an immutable starter commit; it is the single runtime workspace root and receives no duplicate --add-dir or repository-wide extra writable root
experiment.liveHostRequirement: run from a standalone PowerShell outside Codex Desktop; managed CODEX_THREAD_ID or CODEX_PERMISSION_PROFILE markers fail closed before any trial workspace is created
experiment.nativeWindowsRetestPolicy: An independent scheduled-task baseline passed on native Windows after selecting default_permissions=:workspace, approvals_reviewer=auto_review, an external committed trial repository, and a single --cd workspace root; legacy --sandbox or headless approval_policy=never results are not admissible substitutes
experiment.hostParityPolicy: all experiment groups use the same native Codex binary, auth, model, OS sandbox, and controlled capability inventory; only the assigned governance scaffold changes
experiment.controlledRuntimeLoadout: ignore user config and exec rules; disable user/project hooks, plugin hooks, plugins, apps, and tool search for every group so the user's unrelated global automation cannot contaminate the baseline or ablation; the installed skill inventory remains visible and is recorded as shared host context
experiment.resumePolicy: completed trial result files are immutable and reused only when contract and scenario digests match

blindEvaluation.reason: The first lab must avoid circular self-grading and remain exactly replayable.

passCriteria.highCostErrorException: Efficiency overage is allowed only when the full group prevents a held-out cross-file high-risk failure that occurs in baseline.

latestFormalResult.decision: The Fitness Lab itself is accepted because it produced complete promotable evidence. The current full governance bundle is not accepted as generally beneficial: it improved only the fuzzy product task, while simple and high-risk scenarios saturated, and the Review ablation showed no independent benefit.

mustNotClaim: governance effectiveness before the full live matrix completes
